_note: In-season head-coach changes (plus off-season changes flagged in_season=false) for ACB, LBA, GBL, TBL, LNB, BBL, seasons 2020-21 to 2026-27 (2026-27 up to 2026-10-07). Sources: English Wikipedia season 'Coaching/Managerial changes' tables (ACB all seasons, TBL all seasons, LBA 2020-21/2021-22 off-season rows); Italian Wikipedia 'Cambi di allenatore' (LBA 2020-21..2024-25); French Wikipedia 'Changements d'entraineur' (LNB 2020-21..2024-25, incomplete in 2020-21/2021-22/2024-25, supplemented); web research on news sites/club and coach Wikipedia pages (all GBL, BBL 2020-21..2026-27, LNB 2020-21/2021-22/2024-25..2026-27, LBA 2025-26/2026-27). in_season = vacancy_date (or appointment_date if missing) between the league's first and last game of that season (dates from bk_domestic.json); off-season rows from the summer are assigned to the season that follows. Each interim step is its own row (interim=true means the INCOMING coach was interim/caretaker). Dates never invented: null when not found; some BBL/LNB dates are news-publication dates (see note). position = table position from Wikipedia when given. Coverage caveats: LNB 2020-21 and 2021-22 likely incomplete; 2026-27 checks are partial (season only ~2 weeks old). Some GBL rows flagged in_season=true fall after that team's own season ended (playoff elimination) - see note.
